paragraphs: Rav Papa son of Rav Chanin.

He lived in the time of Rav Yosef, as in Menachot 28b, where he recited a teaching before Rav Yosef. Rav Yosef said to him, "Remove yours in favor of mine"; he replied, "On the contrary, remove yours in favor of mine."
In Bava Metzia 113a, he explains the teaching before Rav Yosef under the name Rav Papa, son of Rav Chanin, according to Dikdukei Soferim; the ordinary Gemara has son of Rav Nachman.

notes.text: Bava Metzia 113a explicitly has Rav Papa son of Rav Nachman, with another reading son of Rav Yosef. Hyman cites Chanin from Dikdukei Soferim. The competing baraitot are rejected in each direction in the Menachot quotation.

Menachot 28b directly names Rav Papa son of Chanin before Rav Yosef. The consulted Bava Metzia 113a instead reads son of Nachman, with an alternative son of Yosef; the exact Dikdukei Soferim Chanin reading remains Hyman’s report.
